scope: QuadSpinner Gaea 2.3.1 kernel parameter surfaces and algorithm signatures

method.managed: GaeaDump memb/types/lsns (System.Reflection.Metadata over the shipped PE images); field order preserved from raw dumps
method.native: ASCII symbol-table extraction + dbghelp!UnDecorateSymbolName; no disassembly, no execution
method.obfuscatedNames: PUA field names joined to decompiled node object initializers (evidence/kernels/obfuscated-field-decoding.json)

confidenceVocabulary.observed: read directly from metadata or demangled symbol text

limitations: Gaea.Native/oneAPI/AdaptiveCpp ship no PDB and were not disassembled: only symbol names, signatures, string tables and import linkage were read. Bodies, constants, branch structure and numeric defaults remain unknown.
Parameter struct ABIs: metadata order is recorded, but the native C++ struct layout was not read, so byte offsets are not asserted.
Gaea.CE/CS/CW/TS.dll contain no textual reference to a backend library; the backend is chosen at runtime through function pointers resolved in Gaea.Dv.dll / Gaea.Engine.dll.
Obfuscated names are replaced by 3 private-use-area code points (renaming, not an encoding). Their meaning is stated only where a decompiled node assigns a readable quantity to that exact field.
The decompiled node source is partial (2 MB of Gaea.Nodes.dll): node call sites that are not in it remain unmapped.

cppcliNativeApi.evidence: contiguous export-name block in the shipped string table; the same names appear as string literals in Gaea.Engine.dll and are resolved through SyclLibrary.LoadFunction(handle, functionName)

Snow.nativeNamespaceNote: the C++/CLI core is compiled into Gaea.CS.dll with no separately named namespace in the shipped binaries
